{{Top|leg}}
A '''soul snare''' was a prismatic [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] which had the power to encapsulate the mind and [[Force essence]] of an individual for all of eternity.

==Overview==
===Order of the Terrible Glare===
Soul snares were developed by the [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] of the [[Order of the Terrible Glare/Legends|Order of the Terrible Glare]], a splinter sect of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who utilized the [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] prisms to imprison the [[Force essence]]s of their enemies.<ref name="BF">{{StoryCite|story=Blind Fury!|book=Star Wars Monthly 159}}</ref>

===Rediscovered===
The [[Shi'ido]] [[Borborygmus Gog]] combined technology that he obtained from a [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium|Ssi-ruuvi]] [[Swarm-class battle droid|''Swarm''-class battle droid]] with soul snares to create the [[Essence Stealer]].<ref name="DTF">''{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/81/indexp7.html|text=Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena|int=Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena (article)}}''</ref>

A collection of soul snares was found by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] just before his [[Mission to Garn|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garn/Legends|Garn]], where he encountered [[Rur/Legends|Rur]], the [[High Shaman of the Terrible Glare]]. The crystals were said to be capable of holding a sentient being's life force forever, and although Skywalker had earlier heard of these objects, he had never been aware of their existence until that point.<ref name="BF" />

Rur had used his [[Computer/Legends|computer-body]] to detect if [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielders were near his location. In this way he desired to ensnare [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and imprison them, in vengeance for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Pius Dea Crusades|defeat]] of his splinter faction.<ref name="BF" />

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
These prismatic gem-like objects were first mentioned in the comic ''[[Blind Fury!]]''.
